name: roll-stepper
title: Roll Stepper
description: A number stepper whose figure rolls up or down with each step, speeds up while held and bumps at its limits.

perf.budget: Two text views and one shared value per roll. Holding a button re-renders once per step, down to one step every 45 ms.

a11y.reducedMotion: The figure changes in place, without the roll or the bump at the limits.
a11y.screenReader: An adjustable value named by label, with increment and decrement actions, plus two buttons (Increase and Decrease) that report when a limit is reached.
